newsitem.title: UK: London palladium fix highest since April 5, 1995.
newsitem.headline: London palladium fix highest since April 5, 1995.

text.p: Palladium fixed on Tuesday at $177.50 per ounce, its highest fixing since April 5, 1995.
On Monday afternoon the metal was fixed at $170.00. On May 14, it was fixed at $174.50, its highest level since April 20, 1995.
Dealers said the new high prices reflected palladium's scarcity of supply in a market where demand was growing.
Russia, the world's leading supplier of the metal, has not exported so far this year due to administrative problems, prompting consumers and speculators to buy metal from dealers.
Palladium's scarcity has also sent borrowing rates soaring from a normal one-two percent for a month to over 20 percent.
On Monday a report from Johnson Matthey, the world's biggest refiner of platinum group metals, questioned Russia's future reliability in supplying the rare white metal.
